sql: with t as ( select pt.strategy as bk, pt.market_ticker as tk, pt.assumed_price as px, pt.pnl::float as pnl, pt.closed_at as cl from paper_trades pt where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and pt.market_ticker like 'KXNFLSPREAD-%' ), agg as ( select 'A_book'::text sec, bk::text k, count(*) n, count(distinct tk) mkts, sum(pnl) pnl, avg(px) px, count(*) filter (where pnl<0) losses, avg(pnl) filter (where pnl<0) avgloss, min(cl) f, max(cl) l from t group by 2 union all select 'B_band', case when px<=7 then 'a_<=7' when px<=11 then 'b_08-11' when px<=20 then 'c_12-20' else 'd_21+' end, count(*), count(distinct tk), sum(pnl), avg(px), count(*) filter (where pnl<0), avg(pnl) filter (where pnl<0), min(cl), max(cl) from t group by 2 union all select 'C_week', to_char(date_trunc('week', cl),'MM-DD'), count(*), count(distinct tk), sum(pnl), avg(px), count(*) filter (where pnl<0), avg(pnl) filter (where pnl<0), min(cl), max(cl) from t group by 2 union all select 'D_all', 'ALL', count(*), count(distinct tk), sum(pnl), avg(px), count(*) filter (where pnl<0), avg(pnl) filter (where pnl<0), min(cl), max(cl) from t ) select sec, k, n, mkts, round(pnl::numeric,2) pnl_usd, round((100*pnl/nullif(n,0))::numeric,2) c_per_trade, round(px::numeric,2) entry_c, losses, round((100.0*losses/nullif(n,0))::numeric,1) loss_pct, round(avgloss::numeric,2) avg_loss_usd, f::date first_settle, l::date last_settle from agg order by sec, k
